name: Impish Pestilence gives the Greater Imp the matching Lesser Pestilence, once per 10 s (#375)
contract: Impish Pestilence 300398 (Hellfire level 40 passive) reads 'Using a Pestilence now applies a Lesser Pestilence to your pet. You can only apply a Lesser Pestilence to your pet every 10 sec.' and lists 806962, 802603, 802605 and 802604, the pet ('Rank: Pet') auras, all TARGET_UNIT_PET. By name and effect, Pestilence of Apocalypse 804786 maps to 806962 'Pestilence of Apocalypse' (+10% imp Fire damage, mana every 5 s) and Pestilence of War 802345 maps to 802604 'Pestilence of War' (imp damage may heal the knight). 802604's client tooltip reads 'Emanating a Pestilence of Famine.', a client Spell.dbc text slip that the server does not send. Summon: Greater Imp 520661 summons pet entry 510100. Apocalypse itself stays a beneficial self aura (#224). Pestilences share Category 52 with a 4 s category cooldown, so the switches below wait 4.5 s; a switch inside the 10 s window leaves the imp's previous Lesser Pestilence in place, and the next Pestilence used after the window replaces it.

steps.label: Let login hooks and class synchronisation settle
Force the Impish Pestilence passive aura
Summon: Greater Imp (5 s cast)
SETUP: the Greater Imp is the knight's pet
SETUP: the Impish Pestilence passive is active
Pestilence of Apocalypse
SETUP: Apocalypse is active on the knight
CONTRACT: Apocalypse is a buff on the knight, not a debuff
CONTRACT: the imp gets the Lesser Pestilence of Apocalypse
Let the 10 s Lesser Pestilence window pass
Switch to Pestilence of War
SETUP: War replaced Apocalypse on the knight
CONTRACT: the imp now carries the Lesser Pestilence of War
CONTRACT: the Lesser Pestilence of Apocalypse left the imp
Wait out the 4 s Pestilence category cooldown, still inside the 10 s window
Switch back to Apocalypse inside the window
SETUP: Apocalypse replaced War on the knight
Give a Lesser Pestilence time to land
CONTRACT: inside the 10 s window the imp keeps the Lesser Pestilence of War
CONTRACT: inside the 10 s window the imp does not get Apocalypse
Let the window that War started pass
Use Pestilence of Apocalypse again after the window
CONTRACT: after the window the imp gets the Lesser Pestilence of Apocalypse
CONTRACT: the Lesser Pestilence of War is gone
